title: App Master wake decision
description: The master subagent's whole answer to one wake. Parity with the in-app contract (attention_decide.rs: dispatch/defer/asks/say/note/nextWakeMinutes) so a later replay is lossless. ABSENT-VALUE CONVENTION: every array is present (empty []), say is null when silent; nothing is omitted. Cross-field rules the schema cannot say (enforced by lib/decision.mjs validateDecision): every charter slug of the brief appears exactly once across dispatch and defer; dispatch has at most 2 entries, and with 2 every entry carries a non-empty `paths` and the two are pairwise disjoint (lib/paths.mjs: conservative, an unprovable pair overlaps); no idea id in two dispatches; asks has at most 3; nextWakeMinutes is an integer 10..240; wakeId equals the wake the context was rendered for.

brief.description: The task text for the builder: what to do, in this project's terms.

model.description: Optional builder model (contract.mjs BUILDER_MODEL_CHOICES); overrides the charter default unless the brief pins a model. null or absent = the charter default.

paths.description: Repo-relative path prefixes or globs the builder will touch. Optional for a single dispatch; REQUIRED and non-empty on every entry when there are two, and the two must be disjoint. dispatch refuses `paths overlap` against any live run of the same project; absent means the whole repo.

note.description: The coverage note: what this wake covered and left. The next wake's context quotes it.
